# Third-party notices

## QQSafeChat

The V5 QQ guest driver follows the UIA component-selection and message-container interpretation ideas from QQSafeChat, MIT License, baseline `bdf14db8a6c03525f83412515b55f988b1ec9cae`. No source file was copied. V5 explicitly excludes its SendKeys, clipboard and Enter fallback paths.

## qq-operations

The selector names and QQ NT class conventions were reviewed from qq-operations, MIT License, baseline `d05c0168f421d4b3ed538c29ecc6dba0e523d6b7`. No PowerShell source was copied. V5 stores selectors as certified versioned configuration and requires UIA ValuePattern/InvokePattern.
